title: Categorical reframing of the vortex spectrum
html: While the spectral theory of rigid rotors and Kelvin waves is established, the mathematical synthesis lies in uniting these classical phenomena as evaluations of \mathrm{SU}_q(2) representations over the q-Laplacian. This reframing formally derives vortex intensity levels and selection rules directly from the discrete topology of the q-integer spectrum. It replaces heuristic angular momentum models with exact categorical constraints.
